supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of aegeline against LPS-induced memory dysfunction: involvement of hippocampal cholinergic/proinflammatory cytokines receptor modulation and insilico insight.
supplements.summary: Aegeline, a natural compound, helps protect rat brain memory function by reducing inflammation and preserving cholinergic systems after lipopolysaccharide-induced damage.

supplements.title: Fucoidan potentiates CAR NK cell-mediated antitumor efficacy against non-Hodgkin lymphoma via NRF2.
supplements.summary: Fucoidan enhances CAR NK cell therapy against non-Hodgkin lymphoma by improving cell metabolism, antioxidant activity, and anti-tumor effectiveness.

supplements.title: How Acute and Chronic Exercise Regulate Muscle Atrophic Genes to Mitigate Sarcopenia: A Narrative Review.
supplements.summary: Exercise can mitigate muscle wasting by activating growth pathways and suppressing atrophy genes, potentially helping prevent loss of muscle mass in aging and chronic conditions.

supplements.title: Tumor cell cycle regulation: integrated perspective of stage characteristics, regulatory networks, and signaling pathway intervention strategies.
supplements.summary: The review explores how disrupted cell cycle regulation drives tumor growth and identifies potential targeted therapies by analyzing regulatory networks and signaling pathways.

supplements.title: High-dose vitamin C supplementation in patients undergoing allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation: A pilot randomized, triple-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
supplements.summary: High-dose vitamin C supplementation may reduce complications and improve recovery for patients undergoing stem cell transplantation for blood disorders.

supplements.title: Bufotalin targets COL1A1 to suppress non-small cell lung cancer growth and remodel the tumor microenvironment via dual inhibition of PI3K/AKT/mTOR and MAPK pathways.
supplements.summary: Bufotalin targets COL1A1 in non-small cell lung cancer, simultaneously blocking cancer cell growth and remodeling the tumor environment.

supplements.title: YAP inhibition by gloriosine unlocks autophagic cell death as an anticancer strategy in lung malignancies.
supplements.summary: Gloriosine selectively kills lung adenocarcinoma cells by blocking YAP signaling, triggering autophagy-mediated cell death with minimal damage to normal cells.

supplements.title: Multi-omics profiling reveals that targeting NEK3 synergizes with cuproptosis to promote M1 macrophage polarization in cervical cancer.
supplements.summary: In cervical cancer, targeting the NEK3 protein alongside cuproptosis can help activate immune-fighting macrophages and potentially enhance cancer treatment.

supplements.title: Salidroside alleviates ethanol exposure-exacerbated hepatic insulin resistance in diabetic mice.
supplements.summary: Salidroside effectively mitigates liver insulin resistance caused by excessive alcohol consumption in diabetic mice by reducing inflammation and improving cellular insulin sensitivity.

supplements.title: Sinomenine derivative 1f suppresses glioblastoma through inducing both apoptosis mediated by intrinsic pathway and necroptosis mediated by TNF-α/NF-κB/MAPK signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: A novel sinomenine derivative (1f) effectively targets glioblastoma by triggering two cell death mechanisms, inhibiting tumor growth and improving patient survival.

supplements.title: Target validation and drug discovery for TNBC: Targeting the Lin28B/Let-7/PBK with the ponicidin.
supplements.summary: Ponicidin inhibits triple-negative breast cancer by targeting Lin28B, disrupting its interaction with Let-7 and reducing oncogenic protein expression.

supplements.title: Diosgenin Attenuates Angiogenesis via Targeting Src/STAT3 Signaling Pathway to Treat Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
supplements.summary: To investigate the anti-tumor and anti-angiogenic effects of diosgenin (Dio) in lung cancer.

supplements.title: Multifunctional pectin derivatives as anticancer agents in colorectal cancer via synthesis, computational insights, and modulation of NRF2/HO-1, HIF-1α, and VEGF/PDGF-D signaling pathways.
supplements.summary: This research describes the design, synthesis, characterization, and biological assessment of new Pectin-based Hydrazide and Oxadiazole derivatives as possible anticancer agents.

supplements.title: Crocin Modulates AKT/mTORC1/ULK1 Cascade to Attenuate Ferritinophagy-Induced Colonic Oxidative Injury in Ulcerative Colitis: Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking, and Experimental Validation.
supplements.summary: Crocin reduces oxidative damage in ulcerative colitis by modulating key cellular pathways and protecting against inflammatory cell death in rat colonic tissue.

supplements.title: Fabrication of pea protein isolate-folic acid conjugates via free radical grafting: Formation mechanism, stability, and curcumin delivery potential evaluation.
supplements.summary: Folic acid-modified pea protein successfully improved curcumin delivery, increasing its bioavailability and potential anti-cancer activity for functional food applications.

off_label.title: cRGD-Functionalized macrophage extracellular vesicles loaded with GSK2033 enhance T cell antitumor immunity in GBM by disrupting the LXR/ABCA1-Mediated Myelin lipid transfer axis.
off_label.summary: cRGD-functionalized macrophage extracellular vesicles loaded with GSK2033 enhance T cell immunity by disrupting lipid transfer in glioblastoma, improving tumor treatment.

off_label.title: Therapeutic effects of methotrexate encapsulated in hyaluronic acid-coated exosomes derived from Wharton's jelly mesenchymal stem cells in a rat model of rheumatoid arthritis.
off_label.summary: Methotrexate (MTX) is widely used for treating rheumatoid arthritis (RA); however, its clinical application is limited because of its nonspecific distribution and significant long-term adverse effe...

off_label.title: CRISPR/Cas9-based genome-wide screen reveals a synergistic effect of Irinotecan and USP1 inhibitor in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: In colorectal cancer, combining a USP1 inhibitor with Irinotecan significantly enhances drug effectiveness by disrupting cancer cell repair mechanisms and improving treatment response.

off_label.title: Tucidinostat ameliorates DSS-induced ulcerative colitis by inhibiting cellular senescence, modulating the p53 signaling pathway and cell cycle, and restoring the gut microbiota-metabolite Axis.
off_label.summary: Tucidinostat reduces ulcerative colitis symptoms by inhibiting cellular aging, modulating cell signaling, and restoring beneficial gut bacteria and metabolites.

off_label.title: Complete remission of relapsed ATXN2L::JAK2 fusion positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma following ruxolitinib monotherapy in a child.
off_label.summary: A 13-year-old boy with relapsed ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma achieved complete remission using ruxolitinib after identifying a rare JAK2 gene fusion.

off_label.title: Determinants of access route in single-port off-clamp robotic partial nephrectomy: A contemporary cohort study.
off_label.summary: Tumor location, size, and kidney anatomy help surgeons decide between retroperitoneal or transperitoneal approaches during single-port robotic kidney cancer surgery.

off_label.title: Metformin use and reduced dementia risk in older adults with type 2 diabetes and delirium.
off_label.summary: Diabetes-related delirium markedly impairs cognitive function in older adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and may precede dementia.

off_label.title: Ketoconazole-carbonic anhydrase inhibitors as potential anticancer agents.
off_label.summary: Researchers combined ketoconazole with carbonic anhydrase inhibitors to disrupt cancer cell growth by targeting extracellular vesicle production and enzyme activity.

off_label.title: BRD4-mediated ER membrane contact creates functionally distinct mitochondrial subtypes.
off_label.summary: Fedratinib, an FDA-approved drug, increases communication between endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria, potentially altering cellular metabolism and mitochondrial function.

off_label.title: SLC5A11 Mediates Metformin-Induced PD-L1 Suppression to Enhance Cancer Immunotherapy through AMPK-IRF1 Signaling.
off_label.summary: Metformin suppresses PD-L1 in cancer through SLC5A11, enhancing immunotherapy's effectiveness by boosting T cell response in lung and pancreatic tumors.

off_label.title: Metformin and Oncogenic Pathways: Crosstalk Between Energy Sensing and Tumor Progression.
off_label.summary: Metformin disrupts cancer cell growth by activating AMPK, inhibiting mTOR, and interfering with tumor metabolism and signaling pathways.

off_label.title: From pain relief to proliferation arrest: Synthesis and biological evaluation of novel diclofenac-tethered Schiff bases as VEGFR-2 inhibitors and apoptosis inducers, guided by in silico molecular docking and ADME profiling.
off_label.summary: A novel diclofenac-tethered compound (5a) shows promising anticancer potential by inhibiting VEGFR-2 and inducing apoptosis in breast cancer cells.

off_label.title: Machine learning-driven computational drug repurposing to identify new tubulin inhibitors against cancer.
off_label.summary: Machine learning screening of FDA-approved drugs identified omeprazole and podofilox as potential new tubulin inhibitors against melanoma and colorectal cancer.

off_label.title: Regorafenib and Nifuroxazide exert enhanced suppression of hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting STAT3 and immune remodeling.
off_label.summary: Combining low-dose Regorafenib with Nifuroxazide effectively suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma by inhibiting STAT3 and enhancing anti-tumor immune responses.

off_label.title: Precision screening identifies mitoxantrone as a multitarget inhibitor in ageing-associated cancers with extensive computational validation and doxorubicin comparison.
off_label.summary: Mitoxantrone shows promise as a potential multi-target drug for treating ageing-associated cancers, demonstrating superior performance compared to doxorubicin through computational analysis.

biomarkers.title: Melanoma: a genetics guide for surgeons.
biomarkers.summary: Melanoma is considered the most lethal cutaneous malignancy when not detected early and treated at early stages.

biomarkers.title: Determinants of adjuvant treatment choice between immunotherapy (immune checkpoint inhibitor) and targeted therapy in resected stage III BRAF V600-mutated cutaneous melanoma: a multicenter observational study: MELADJ3.
biomarkers.summary: In stage III BRAF-mutated melanoma, younger working patients preferred targeted therapy, while older patients chose immunotherapy, based on personal lifestyle and medical follow-up preferences.

biomarkers.title: Neuroprotective effects of aegeline against LPS-induced memory dysfunction: involvement of hippocampal cholinergic/proinflammatory cytokines receptor modulation and insilico insight.
biomarkers.summary: Aegeline, a natural compound, helps protect rat brain memory function by reducing inflammation and preserving cholinergic systems after lipopolysaccharide-induced damage.

biomarkers.title: Fucoidan potentiates CAR NK cell-mediated antitumor efficacy against non-Hodgkin lymphoma via NRF2.
biomarkers.summary: Fucoidan enhances CAR NK cell therapy against non-Hodgkin lymphoma by improving cell metabolism, antioxidant activity, and anti-tumor effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: SLC38A5 drives colorectal cancer ferroptosis resistance through the Hippo-YAP/Nrf2 axis.
biomarkers.summary: SLC38A5 promotes colorectal cancer resistance to ferroptosis by activating protective cellular pathways through YAP and Nrf2 signaling.

biomarkers.title: The expression and significance of CXCL13 and CXCR5 in the tumor microenvironment of primary central nervous system diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
biomarkers.summary: PCNS-DLBCL (Primary central nervous system diffuse large B cell lymphoma) is a rare extranodal non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

biomarkers.title: Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Triple Negative Breast Cancer: A Systematic Review of Breast and Node Pathologic Response.
biomarkers.summary: In triple-negative breast cancer, neoadjuvant chemotherapy shows varying complete response rates between breast tumors and lymph nodes, potentially impacting future surgical approaches.

biomarkers.title: Human-derived cardiac-neural microtissues reveal catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia is also a disease of the sympathetic neuron.
biomarkers.summary: In catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, dysfunctional sympathetic neurons can directly trigger cardiac arrhythmias, revealing the disease as a neurological disorder.

biomarkers.title: Pilocytic astrocytoma in pediatric and adult patients: a single-center analysis of 650 cases.
biomarkers.summary: A comprehensive study of 650 pilocytic astrocytoma cases revealed distinct age-related differences in tumor characteristics and found that complete surgical removal and low mitotic activity predict better patient outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Characterization of tumour microenvironment in thymic epithelial tumours of different histological subtypes.
biomarkers.summary: Thymic epithelial tumours (TETs) include several World Health Organization (WHO) defined histological subtypes, ranging from indolent thymomas to highly aggressive thymic carcinoma (TC).

biomarkers.title: The likely possibility of predicting treatment outcomes of cervical lesions using serum FOXP3 and P16INK4A as shown by a cohort study in South Western Uganda.
biomarkers.summary: The study suggests that blood levels of FOXP3 and P16INK4A could help predict treatment outcomes for cervical lesions in Uganda.

biomarkers.title: Association between baseline prostate MRI PI-RADS classification and risk of Gleason upgrade during active surveillance: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Higher baseline PI-RADS scores on prostate MRI are associated with increased risk of Gleason grade progression in low-risk prostate cancer patients under active surveillance.

biomarkers.title: Endocrine carcinoma with amphicrine carcinoma component at esophagogastric junction.
biomarkers.summary: Amphicrine carcinoma is a rare malignancy exhibiting both endocrine and exocrine differentiation within the same tumor cells.

biomarkers.title: DSG2+ Cancer Stem Cells Co-Located With FAP+ Myofibroblasts in the Tumor Boundary That Determines the Efficacy of Immunotherapy in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: In non-small cell lung cancer, DSG2+ cancer stem cells near FAP+ myofibroblasts at tumor boundaries influence therapy resistance and cancer progression.

biomarkers.title: UBE2T-Driven p53 Degradation Rewires Glycolysis to Orchestrate Lactylation-Mediated CAFs Activation and ECM Deposition in Pancreatic Cancer.
biomarkers.summary: In pancreatic cancer, UBE2T drives metabolic changes that increase lactate production, activating cancer-associated fibroblasts and hindering immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: Uptake of cascade tests in relatives of patients undergoing cancer precision medicine in Japan.
trials.summary: In a Japanese study, researchers examined how many relatives of cancer patients chose to undergo genetic testing after a precision medicine diagnosis.

trials.title: SiCmiR Atlas: Single-Cell miRNA Landscape Reveals Hub-miRNA and Network Signatures in Human Cancers.
trials.summary: SiCmiR, a neural network method, accurately predicts single-cell microRNA expression across multiple cancer types using limited gene data.

trials.title: High-Content SRS Imaging Unveils Altered Cholesterol Metabolism in Ovarian Cancers Under CAR-T Treatment.
trials.summary: High-content imaging reveals ovarian cancer cells survive CAR-T therapy by altering cholesterol metabolism, which can be disrupted to improve treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: NK Cell Activation by Platinum Boosts Immunotherapy in HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer.
trials.summary: Platinum treatment activates natural killer cells, enhancing immunotherapy's effectiveness in hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer.
